result: A universal seven-source word of k = 22 complete source calls and W = 24 toggle-adds in the singleton+DUO alphabet of research/universal-connector-boundary extended by research/duo-toggle-connector's charged pair-source DUO family. Steps are integers in 0..127 (bit i = source label i); a step of Hamming weight 2 is one charged DUO call B_jk: z += B_j x_j + B_k x_k.

side_row_21_26.note: Same search, different (k, d) target. Incomparable with (22, 24): one fewer call and two extra adds, cheaper when o > 2p. Neither word is proved globally Pareto-optimal; recorded as search evidence.

batch_bill_all_127_rows.tariff: In c_B = o + p, c_DUO = o + 2p, c_A = o + p the batch totals are 278o + 278p (Gray) and 276o + 278p (this word): strictly better for every o > 0, saving exactly 2 per-call overheads o with total adds unchanged.
